notes.title: 06.25.25 Version 0.2
notes.notes:
Added interface and subtitle support for the following languages: EN, ES, IT, PT, TR, DE, JA, KO, RU, FR, ZH, HI
Risks like hunger, contamination, and pest bites have been added. These currently affect your walking speed.
Added Hotel, Hospital, and Hotdog Truck to help players recover, clean up, and eat on the go.
Various improvements and fixes made to in-game scripts for better performance and flow.
